profile.headline: Customer Platform Engineer | CRM • Web • AI | Building Connected Digital Customer Experiences
profile.summary:
I’m a technology leader and hands-on engineer focused on building the platforms that connect companies with their customers.

At Trinity Trailer, my work spans CRM, customer-facing web platforms, system integrations, and AI. I lead the architecture and development of technology that supports the customer journey—from marketing and sales engagement through customer self-service and ongoing support.

My focus is on creating connected, scalable platforms rather than isolated applications. That includes modernizing CRM and sales processes, building and evolving customer-facing websites and portals, integrating business systems, and developing AI-powered knowledge and automation solutions.

I enjoy working at the intersection of technology and business—understanding how teams operate, identifying where technology can simplify or improve a process, and then designing and building the solution.

My core areas of focus include:

• CRM architecture, development, and automation
• Customer portals and digital self-service experiences
• Marketing websites and digital customer experience
• AI-powered knowledge, search, and business applications
• API and business-system integrations
• Customer data and workflow automation
• Platform architecture and technology strategy

I’m particularly interested in how AI is changing the way organizations connect their data, systems, employees, and customers. My goal is to build practical AI solutions that solve real business problems—not simply implement technology for technology’s sake.

I’m at my best in roles where I can combine hands-on engineering with platform ownership, architecture, cross-functional collaboration, and long-term technology strategy.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer/Marketing Operations Manager
positions.description:
Lead the development and evolution of Trinity Trailer’s customer technology ecosystem, with responsibility spanning CRM, customer-facing web platforms, digital experiences, system integrations, and AI-enabled solutions. Work cross-functionally with business and technology leadership to translate operational and customer needs into scalable technology solutions.

• Modernized Trinity Trailer’s CRM environment by consolidating platforms into HubSpot, reducing system complexity and creating a more unified foundation for sales and customer engagement.

• Redesigned and automated sales processes within the CRM, integrating business systems and customer order information to improve workflow efficiency and visibility.

• Rebuilt Trinity Trailer’s corporate website with a modernized user experience and migrated the platform from WordPress to HubSpot.

• Rebuilt the Thirty3 Capital website and transitioned it from WordPress to HubSpot, improving platform consistency and maintainability.

• Architect and develop customer-facing web applications and portal capabilities designed to expand digital self-service and improve the customer experience.

• Develop AI-powered internal and customer-facing solutions, including an Azure-based conversational platform that connects users with organizational knowledge and business information.

• Design integrations across CRM, web applications, AI services, and internal business systems to create a more connected customer technology stack.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and develop proofs of concept to identify practical opportunities for AI, automation, and digital transformation.

• Serve as a primary technical resource for customer-facing platforms, providing hands-on engineering, architecture, technical direction, and long-term platform planning.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Web Development · HubSpot · Marketing Attribution · Software Development · Reporting & Analysis · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Server · Azure Functions · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Marketing Operations Manager
positions.description:
- Implemented ABM motion using 6sense in partnership with the Sales team
- Provided weekly reporting and analysis of pipeline progress, website visits, branded search, and demo/pricing requests
- Implemented new marketing attribution model in tandem with the RevOps team
- Responsible for all marketing website development and Hubspot list management, workflows, and email campaigns
